## Current model

For $n$ observations for one tree $k$ of the species $sp$ on the stand $p$:

$$
\vec{\text{rw}}_{sp,p,k} = 
\begin{bmatrix}
  \text{rw}_{sp,p,k}(t_1) \\
  \text{rw}_{sp,p,k}(t_2) \\
  \vdots \\
  \text{rw}_{sp,k}(t_n)
\end{bmatrix}
$$ 

## Current model

For $n$ observations for one tree $k$ of the species $sp$ on the stand $p$:

$$\log\vec{\text{rw}}_{sp,p,k} \sim \text{multinormal}(\vec{\mu}_{sp,p} + \vec{f}_{\text{long},k}, \hspace{0.08cm} \vec{\Sigma})$$

$$\vec{f}_{\text{long},k} \sim \text{multinormal}(\vec{0}, \vec{\mathrm{K}}_{sp})$$

## Long-term Gaussian process

One \textbf{long-term scale} Gaussian process $\vec{f}_{\text{long},k}$ for each tree $k$,
to capture the long-term variation of tree growth, likely related to allometric constraints  

- one pair of parameters $\{\gamma_{\text{sp}}, \rho_{\text{sp}}\}$ per species $sp$, which defined one covariance matrix $\vec{\mathrm{K}}_{sp}$ per species
- prior mass of $\rho_{\text{sp}}$ between 20 and 60 years

## Current model

For $n$ observations for one tree $k$ of the species $sp$ on the stand $p$:

$$\log\vec{\text{rw}}_{sp,p,k} \sim \text{multinormal}(\vec{\mu}_{sp,p} + \vec{f}_{\text{long},k}, \hspace{0.08cm} \vec{\Sigma})$$

$$\vec{f}_{\text{long},k} \sim \text{multinormal}(\vec{0}, \vec{\mathrm{K}}_{sp})$$

## The climate behavior

::: {style="font-size: 70%;"}
$$
\vec{\mu}_{sp,p} = 
\begin{bmatrix}
  \mu_{sp,p}(t_1) \\
  \mu_{sp,p}(t_2) \\
  \vdots \\
  \mu_{sp,p}(t_n)
\end{bmatrix}
$$
:::

The elements $\mu_{sp,p}(t)$ are built up from the short-term scale GP and from contributions of three climate variables:

::: {style="font-size: 70%;"}
$$ \begin{split} 
\forall i  \in [\![1,\mathrm{n}]\!]  \hspace{1cm} \mu_{sp,p}(t_i)= \alpha
    + \beta_{\text{GDD}} * \text{GDD}(p,t_i)
    + \beta_{\text{SM}}  * \text{SM}(p,t_i)\\
    + \beta_{\text{VPD}}  * \text{VPD}(p,t_i)
    + \kappa_{\text{sp}}
    * f_{\text{short,p}}(t_i)
     \end{split} $$

$$\vec{f}_{\text{short},p} \sim \text{multinormal}(\vec{0}, \vec{\mathrm{K}}_\text{short})$$
:::

## Short-term Gaussian process

One \textbf{short-term scale} Gaussian process $\vec{f}_{\text{short},p}$ per stand $p$, to capture climatic variations that span several years

- two parameters $\{\gamma_{\text{short}}, \rho_{\text{short}}\}$, which defined one covariance matrix $\vec{\mathrm{K}}_\text{short}$ common across all stands
- does not depend on species, but its effect is scaled by a factor $\kappa_\text{sp}$
- prior mass of $\rho_{\text{short}}$ between 3 and 10 years

## Our climate predictors

Three climate variables, occuring at the annual-scale

- the growing degree days $\text{GDD}(p,t_i)$ accumulated during the entire year, in $\text{x}100$ $^{\circ}\text{C}$
- the mean soil moisture $\text{SM}(p,t_i)$ (weighted average across soil horizons) during summer, in $\%$
- the mean vapor pressure deficit $\text{VPD}(p,t_i)$ during summer, in $\text{hPa}$

\begin{itemize}
    \item the growing season length $\text{GSL}(p,t_i)$, in days
